mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, (ARRAY_AGG(s.photo_url ORDER BY s.taken_at, s.id))[1] AS photo_url, COUNT(s.id) AS sighting_count FROM cats c JOIN sightings s ON s.cat_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT t.cat_id, t.tag FROM cat_tags t JOIN cats c ON c.id = t.cat_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.cat_id, t.id
